review:
King Midas's underworld on a 5x3 grid – chests, chalices and his golden daughter. Wilds land as 1x or with multipliers up to 10x, and every wild multiplier is collected and applied to the total win.

Three golden-hand scatters trigger free spins, with three mini reels deciding how many (one to three each). In the bonus, wilds stick and multipliers never reset, so they keep stacking up all round. Up to 8,000x, 96.07% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
